name: LGMS Berhad
overview: LGMS Berhad 于2026年1月完成收购 Antarex Holdings Sdn Bhd 27.0% 股权，代价 RM22.68 million，其中 RM16.065 million 已支付，余额 RM6.615 million 按盈利保证安排保留。公司于2026年1月19日完成转板上市。此外，公司宣派2026财年首次中期股息0.5仙及2025财年末期股息1.2仙。
overview_en: LGMS Berhad completed the acquisition of a 27.0% equity interest in Antarex Holdings Sdn Bhd in January 2026 for a purchase consideration of RM22.68 million, of which RM16.065 million was paid with the remaining RM6.615 million retained under a profit guarantee arrangement. The company completed a transfer of listing on 19 January 2026. In addition, the company declared a first interim dividend of 0.5 sen for FY2026 and a final dividend of 1.2 sen for FY2025.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 完成收购 Antarex Holdings 27.0% 股权，并完成转板上市。
segments.note_en: Completed the acquisition of a 27.0% equity interest in Antarex Holdings and completed the transfer of listing.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 完成收购 Antarex Holdings Sdn Bhd 27.0% 股权，代价 RM22.68 million，已支付 RM16.065 million，余额 RM6.615 million 按盈利保证安排保留。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of a 27.0% equity interest in Antarex Holdings Sdn Bhd for a purchase consideration of RM22.68 million, with RM16.065 million paid and the remaining RM6.615 million retained under a profit guarantee arrangement.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 补充买卖协议的条件于2026年1月12日全部达成，协议变为无条件，收购预计于2026年1月底完成。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent to the supplemental share sale agreement were fulfilled on 12 January 2026, making the agreement unconditional, and the acquisition was expected to complete by end-January 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 于2026年1月8日与 AHSB 及 Tan Pek Loon 签订补充买卖协议，继续收购 AHSB 27.0% 股权。
actions.text_en: Entered into a supplemental share sale agreement with AHSB and Tan Pek Loon on 8 January 2026 to continue acquiring the 27.0% equity interest in AHSB.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购 Antarex Holdings Sdn Bhd 27.0% 股权，将业务延伸至该公司所在领域。
model_changes.text_en: Through the acquisition of a 27.0% equity interest in Antarex Holdings Sdn Bhd, the company extended its business into the sector in which Antarex operates.
